title: Send the weekly recruiting recap
intro: We will open the Work tab, add a line to the recap by voice, and send it to the team chat.

steps.say: This is a dashboard with made-up data. Nothing is sent. We start on the Work tab.
The numbers come from your connected systems, and the recap is already written.
Add a line by voice. Turn on the microphone and talk.
act: Please add your interview availability by Friday.

steps.say: Your words join the message. Now press Send to team chat.
The demo says nothing was sent. In the real dashboard, the message goes out only when you press Send.
That is the whole workflow. Press Replay to watch it again.
